notes: Adds remaining enforcement completeness: config management, audit logging, and runtime safeguards.

change_log.note: Externalize allowlist rules for maintainability and auditability
Ensure all enforcement decisions are traceable
Guarantee secure defaults under failure conditions

stories.title: Config-Driven Allowlist Definition
stories.description: Implement centralized configuration for allowed collections, fields, operators, and query limits. Configuration must be environment-aware and loaded at runtime, enabling updates without code changes while maintaining strict validation compatibility.

stories.title: Enforcement Audit Logging
stories.description: Log all enforcement decisions including accepted, rejected, and modified requests with reason codes. Logs must include request metadata, violated rule, and enforcement outcome to support QA, SIT, and security audits.

stories.title: Fail-Closed Runtime Safeguards
stories.description: Ensure system defaults to fail-closed behavior under all error conditions (schema failure, config load failure, validation exception). No request may reach MongoDB unless explicitly validated and allowed.
